name: Protagonist
source:
A sharp-tongued delinquent and the only male in the group. 

[Spoiler]Sickness:

Hematophilia: Sexual arousal derived from seeing, smelling, and/or consuming blood. After his "switch" is flipped, he loses control of himself and just craves blood. 

He pretends to be rough and tough, but in reality he's a sensitive and kind person. Driven by loneliness and the the wish to not hurt anyone, he decided to commit suicide. 

After reconciling with [url=/c102769]his sister[/url], he decides against committing suicide and finally chooses to live.[/spoiler]

[Based on the in-game profile] 

[Spoiler]His "sickness" was induced artificially by [url=/c154435]Kozue Benika[/url].

His real name is Amashiro Tagui (天城 類).[/spoiler]
